raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Fixes a prefill-engine crash in disaggregated serving of hybrid models: `AssertionError: No free recurrent-state slots for 1 expert-parallel dummy request(s)`.

`run_engine_with_coordinator` reuses the last EP work/pause consensus for up to `ep_consensus_interval` (20) iterations while that consensus showed work, to amortize the EP all-reduce. The cache was also used when the EP group has a single rank, where the consensus is just the local work count. When an EP=1 engine drained inside that window, it acted on the stale `global_work > 0` and called `controller.dummy_forward()`, an expert-parallel dummy step with no peers to join.

On hybrid models the dummy step needs a recurrent-state slot. Only EP > 1 contexts reserve a dedicated dummy slot, so EP=1 allocates from the request pool. A disaggregated prefill engine detaches each finished request's Mamba slot until decode releases the handoff, and the coordinator admits up to `max_requests` such handoffs, so with decode saturated every slot can be held while the prefill engine has no local work. The stale dummy step then fails and kills the engine. Reproduced with Nemotron-3-Nano, three TP=1/EP=1 prefill engines and one decode engine on one GB200 node, at 36-40 req/s.

The fix refreshes the consensus every step when `ep_world_size == 1`. The consensus is local and free there, so global work equals local work and the dummy branch cannot be reached without peers. EP=1 engines also stop running up to 19 idle dummy forwards after each drain and act on a pause at the next iteration. EP > 1 behavior (amortized consensus, reserved dummy slot, CUDA-graph replay of the dummy step) is unchanged.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: none (found while benchmarking disaggregated serving).

## Code provenance

No external code.

## Testing

- New tests in `tests/unit_tests/inference/test_disagg_handoff_lifecycle.py`:
  - `test_idle_prefill_without_expert_parallelism_skips_dummy_forward` runs the real coordinator loop on an EP=1 disaggregated prefill engine that drains inside the consensus interval and asserts no dummy forward. It fails without the fix at `dynamic_engine.py:5237` with the production error message.
  - `test_idle_expert_parallel_rank_keeps_amortized_consensus_dummy_forward` (EP=2, busy peer) asserts the amortized consensus and dummy forwards are unchanged.
- Existing suites on GB200 (4 GPUs per node, so 8-rank parametrizations skip or error): disaggregation handoff/coordinator/scheduler/engine-factory/mamba-metadata 172 passed; data-parallel and prefix-caching coordinator 102 passed (1 error: a tp2-pp2-ep2 case needing 8 ranks); `test_dynamic_context.py` 165 passed; `test_dynamic_engine.py` 260 passed, 3 skipped.
- End-to-end reproducer (3 prefill + 1 decode, Nemotron-3-Nano, 4096-token prompts, 256 output tokens): unfixed, 1027 errors at 36 req/s and all 2400 requests failed at 40 req/s; fixed, 2160/2160 and 2400/2400 completed with 0 errors.

@@ -5676,10 +5676,16 @@ async def run_engine_with_coordinator(
                     )
                     global_work_from_last_consensus, _ = self._last_ep_consensus
                     if (
-                        global_work_from_last_consensus == 0

                         or self._ep_consensus_loop_counter % self.ep_consensus_interval == 0
                     ):
                         # selectively enter ep_establish_consensus if
+                        # 0. there are no EP peers -> consensus is local and free. A cached value
+                        #    goes stale once local work drains and would trigger a dummy forward
+                        #    with no collective to join. Such a dummy forward would also need a
+                        #    request-owned recurrent-state slot (the dedicated dummy slot is only
+                        #    reserved for EP > 1), which pending handoffs may all be holding.
                         # 1. there is no global work -> engine is idle. At any step in the future
                         #    one of the ranks can receive work. So we should be eagerly checking for that
                         # 2. it has been 20 steps since we last established consensus, and that consensus

@@ -39,7 +39,11 @@
     PendingSSMImport,
 )
 from megatron.core.inference.disaggregation.transfer_backends.base import TransferStartError
-from megatron.core.inference.engines.dynamic_engine import DynamicInferenceEngine, RequestEntry
+from megatron.core.inference.engines.dynamic_engine import (
+    DynamicInferenceEngine,
+    EngineState,
+    RequestEntry,
+)
 from megatron.core.inference.inference_request import (
     DynamicInferenceRequest,
     DynamicInferenceRequestRecord,
@@ -2022,3 +2026,96 @@ def stage_ssm_metas(stage):
         is not requests[1].disaggregated_params["kv_meta"]
     )
     assert all("ssm" not in meta for meta in engine._kv_peer_metas)
+
+
+class _CoordinatorLoopPrefillEngine(DisaggDynamicInferenceEngine):
+    """Prefill engine shell that drives the real coordinator loop on scripted work."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, ep_world_size, peer_work, iterations, dummy_forward) -> None:
+        self._initialize_disaggregation_state()
+        self._kv_transfer_role = "prefill"
+        self.state = EngineState.RUNNING
+        self.rank = 0
+        self.tp_ep_world_size = ep_world_size
+        self.ep_consensus_interval = 20
+        self._ep_consensus_loop_counter = 0
+        self._last_ep_consensus = (0, False)
+        self.use_synchronous_zmq_collectives = False
+        self.waiting_request_ids = deque([7])
+        self.context = SimpleNamespace(
+            step_count=0, prefix_cache_lru_clock=0, get_active_request_count=lambda: 0
+        )
+        self.controller = SimpleNamespace(dummy_forward=dummy_forward)
+        self.step_start_event = mock.Mock()
+        self.step_end_event = mock.Mock()
+        self.step_calls = 0
+        self.all_reduce_inputs = []
+        self._peer_work = peer_work
+        self._iterations_left = iterations
+        if ep_world_size > 1:
+            self.expert_parallel_zmq_communicator = SimpleNamespace(
+                all_reduce_max=self._all_reduce_max
+            )
+
+    async def _all_reduce_max(self, local_work, consensus, async_op):
+        self.all_reduce_inputs.append(local_work)
+        return max(local_work, self._peer_work), consensus
+
+    def schedule_requests(self):
+        self._iterations_left -= 1
+        if self._iterations_left < 0:
+            self.state = EngineState.STOPPING
+        return 0
+
+    async def async_step(self, *, verbose=False):
+        # The prompt finishes prefill in one step and leaves the batch; its detached
+        # recurrent-state slot stays pinned until decode releases the handoff.
+        self.step_calls += 1
+        self.waiting_request_ids.clear()
+        await asyncio.sleep(0)
+
+    async def shutdown(self):
+        return None
+
+
+def _run_coordinator_loop(engine, loop):
+    run = DynamicInferenceEngine.run_engine_with_coordinator.__wrapped__
+    loop.run_until_complete(asyncio.wait_for(run(engine, loop=loop), timeout=30))
+
+
+def test_idle_prefill_without_expert_parallelism_skips_dummy_forward(handoff_loop):
+    """A drained EP=1 engine must not act on a cached EP consensus.
+
+    Pending handoffs may hold every request-owned recurrent-state slot, and EP=1 reserves no
+    dummy slot, so a dummy forward here fails to allocate a slot and kills the engine.
+    """
+    dummy_forward = mock.Mock(
+        side_effect=AssertionError(
+            "No free recurrent-state slots for 1 expert-parallel dummy request(s)"
+        )
+    )
+    engine = _CoordinatorLoopPrefillEngine(
+        ep_world_size=1, peer_work=0, iterations=4, dummy_forward=dummy_forward
+    )
+
+    _run_coordinator_loop(engine, handoff_loop)
+
+    assert engine.step_calls == 1
+    dummy_forward.assert_not_called()
+    assert engine.context.step_count == 0
+    assert engine._last_ep_consensus == (0, False)
+
+
+def test_idle_expert_parallel_rank_keeps_amortized_consensus_dummy_forward(handoff_loop):
+    """EP>1 ranks still reuse consensus within the interval and join busy peers."""
+    dummy_forward = mock.Mock()
+    engine = _CoordinatorLoopPrefillEngine(
+        ep_world_size=2, peer_work=1, iterations=4, dummy_forward=dummy_forward
+    )
+
+    _run_coordinator_loop(engine, handoff_loop)
+
+    assert engine.all_reduce_inputs == [1]
+    assert engine.step_calls == 1
+    assert dummy_forward.call_count == 3
+    assert engine.context.step_count == 3
